name: colIQRs
title: Estimates the interquartile range for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Estimates of the interquartile range for each row (column) in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colIQRs(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE, ...,
  useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An integer, numeric, or logical N by K matrix.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.
Additional arguments passed to colQuantiles, including type, digits, and fuzz.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The value is the 0.75 column quantile minus the 0.25 column quantile. A missing value with na.rm FALSE returns NA_real_.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length K, one interquartile range per selected column.

translation.description: Estimates the interquartile range for each column in a matrix.
translation.usage:
colIQRs(x, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, use_names=True, type=7,
  digits=7, fuzz=None)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An N by K array. Axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If true, missing values are dropped. Otherwise a column with a missing value is nan.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: If true, .names carries the column names. An array without column names stays unnamed.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Quantile type passed to colQuantiles. The default is 7.

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Accepted because colQuantiles checks it when names are requested.

arguments.name: fuzz
arguments.text: Passed through to the quantile estimator.

translation.details: Calls colQuantiles at 0.25 and 0.75 with drop false, then subtracts the first column from the second.
translation.value: A one-dimensional array of length equal to the selected columns. Calculated ranges are float64.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowiqrs import colIQRs

colIQRs(np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F"))
